motion: Sets the easing curves and springs of animations.
button-link: Shows a navigation link with button styles, for any router.
button-styles: Sets the variants and sizes of buttons and button links.
chart: Frames a TanStack chart with shadcn chart colors and tooltip styles.
collapsible-panel: Animates a disclosure panel and keeps its content accessible.
date-segment: Shows the editable segments of date and time fields.
field-styles: Sets the theme styles of text and segmented fields.
item-highlight: Moves one highlight to the hovered or focused item.
press-button: Handles press interactions for shared button controls.
size: Sets one size scale for buttons, toggles, and their groups.
typography: Sets the size, line height, and spacing of headings, text, lists, tables, and code in HTML content.
